desc.short: Many buildings with numerous dark alleys.
desc.long:
Many wooden buildings of various sizes and shapes fill this district. A maze of dark alleys begins here, leading deeper into the district.

People walk in small groups, speaking quietly to each other, typically with their heads hidden under hoods. Mercenaries sit against buildings, caring for their equipment or drinking silently.

The air is thick with the smell of cooking meat and ale. The Tower dominates the skyline to the south and a road leads in that direction. To the east is a well-worn tavern with an enormous novelty tankard hanging over the door, covered in rust.
